verdicts.reason: A is broken. The circle is pulled away from the can and sits behind the GLACIER wordmark and the body copy. The CTA has shrunk to a small pill that is crammed into the top corner with the badges, and the badges wrap raggedly. The brand mark now sits below the headline and the can floats alone, so the reading order is lost. B keeps the can and circle together and keeps the hierarchy (headline, copy, badges, CTA), but nothing shares a left edge: GLACIER, the headline block, the badges and the CTA each start at a different x, so the layout drifts diagonally. The right half of the top is empty dead space next to the circle, and the CTA is not aligned with anything.
